name: Writing studio
author: RdotA
description: Tighten, re-tone and proofread anything you write.

prompts.title: Tighten this
prompts.text:
Make this clearer and shorter without losing meaning or my voice. Show the new version, then list the main cuts:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Change the tone
prompts.text:
Rewrite this in a {ask:Tone} tone, keeping every fact the same:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Notes to email
prompts.text:
Turn these notes into a friendly, well-organised email to {ask:Who is it for}. Keep it brief and end with a clear next step:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Headline ideas
prompts.text: Give me ten headline or title ideas for this, from straightforward to playful:

prompts.title: Proofread
prompts.text:
Proofread this. Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation only, and list each change you made:

{clipboard}
